          (number)
          (string)
          (number))))))

================================================================================
MERGE with each kind of WHEN
================================================================================

MERGE INTO accounts AS a
USING (SELECT * FROM deposits) AS d
ON a.id = d.account
WHEN MATCHED AND d.amount = 0 THEN DELETE
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET balance = a.balance + d.amount
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, balance) VALUES (d.account, d.amount);

---

(source_file
  (merge_statement
    (object_reference
      (identifier))
    (identifier)
    (derived_table
      (subquery
        (select
          (star_expression)
          (from_clause
            (table_reference
              (object_reference
                (identifier))))))
      (identifier))
    (binary_expression
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (operator)
      (column_reference
        (identifier)
        (identifier)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (binary_expression
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (operator)
        (number)))
    (merge_when_clause
      (assignment
        (identifier)
        (binary_expression
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier))
          (operator)
          (column_reference
            (identifier)
            (identifier)))))
    (merge_when_clause
      (column_list
        (identifier)
        (identifier))
      (row_constructor
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))
        (column_reference
          (identifier)
          (identifier))))))
